en.description:
HerJourney is a women's health tracker that follows you through four stages of life, and keeps what you log on your own device.

—— Four journeys ——

CYCLE
Log periods, flow and symptoms. See where you are in your cycle — menstrual, follicular, ovulation or luteal — and what typically comes next.

TRYING TO CONCEIVE
An ovulation calculator estimates your fertile window from your cycle length and last period.

PREGNANCY
A due-date calculator works out how far along you are and when to expect the birth, week by week.

MENOPAUSE
Track the symptoms that matter through perimenopause and after, in the same place as everything else.

—— Log what matters ——

• Periods, flow and cycle length
• Symptoms, mood and notes, day by day
• Weight, water and the metrics you care about
• Charts that show how things move over time

—— Works with Apple Health and Health Connect ——

Grant access once and HerJourney reads steps, heart rate, HRV, sleep, respiratory rate, blood oxygen, body temperature, active energy and weight, so you do not type in what your phone or watch already knows. It writes menstrual flow, water and weight back, so your other health apps stay in step. Declining leaves every other feature working.

—— Your data stays with you ——

Everything you log is written to a database on your device. There is no advertising SDK and no analytics SDK in the app, and nothing you log is uploaded. Signing in with Apple or Google is entirely optional and is not required to use anything.

—— Not medical advice ——

HerJourney is an education and self-tracking tool. It is not a medical device, it does not diagnose anything, and it is not contraception. Estimated fertile windows and due dates are calculations from the dates you enter, not clinical predictions. Talk to a clinician about any decision concerning your health.

review_information.notes:
2. DEVICES AND OS VERSIONS TESTED
Automated tests run on every build: iPhone 17 Pro Max and iPad Pro 13-inch simulators on iOS 26, and a Pixel Android emulator on API 34.
Each release is also installed and launched on those targets, so a
build that cannot start never ships.

3. WHAT THIS APP DOES, AND FOR WHOM
HerJourney is a women's health tracker that follows you through four stages of life, and keeps what you log on your own device.

Intended audience:
Cycle, pregnancy, menopause

4. SETTING UP AND REACHING THE MAIN FEATURES
No account and no login are required. Every feature is reachable from the first screen after launch.

5. EXTERNAL SERVICES USED
- Supabase — account and data storage
- Google Sign-In — authentication
- Sign in with Apple — authentication
- HTTPS requests to the app's own endpoints

6. REGIONAL DIFFERENCES
The app ships 12 languages (Arabic, Chinese (Simplified), English, French, German, Hindi, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese, Russian, Spanish). Features are identical in every region.

7. REGULATED INDUSTRY OR THIRD-PARTY MATERIAL

The app is not in a regulated industry and carries no licensed third-party material. All content, artwork and copy are the developer's own.


ACCOUNT DELETION
The app creates no account, so there is nothing to delete.
